title: Officer cleared in shooting
article: A police officer who shot a Moosonee man did not commit a criminal offence, the province's police watchdog has concluded.
Maurice Linklater, 29, died Jan. 14 of a single gunshot wound.

"The officer shot Mr. Linklater on the basis of an objectively reasonable belief that his life or the life of others in the vicinity was in danger," said Peter A. Tinsley, director of the province's Special Investigations Unit.
Tinsley said that evidence from the investigation "supports the view" that Linklater was shot while carrying a loaded shotgun and walking toward a police officer.
The unit also said that the officer who shot Linklater fired a warning shot into the ground, but Linklater ignored it.
